messages:
carla: Heads up — ran nightly fusion/flash mix benchmark and saw a ~22% regression on the Llama-13B long-context workload when the kernel selector picked the FlashMix variant with interleaved KV.
carla: nvprof/trace attached in profiling job but TL;DR: kernel time for attention spike at step ~2400 tokens.
carla: sample log: `flashmix_attn_kernel (grid=..., block=...)  time=3.12ms vs baseline 2.55ms`
devin: hmm, did the scheduler change batching heuristic recently?
marta: we flipped the dynamic-stride detector on Monday in canary, supposed to improve fused->paged fallback.
devin: that detector can bias toward FlashMix because it assumes aligned strides; if KV is interleaved with dtype cast to bf16 it might mispredict.
carla: KV layout for this job is interleaved, dtype=bf16, stride ~96 bytes.
raj: can you paste the small profile snippet from perf-bot?
perf-bot: JOB 2052345678: /profiles/2052345678/trace.nsys -> top kernels: flashmix_attn 54%, kv_copy 11%, fused_attention 9%
carla: also saw increased L2 read/write from NVTX zones around `kv_read_interleave`
marta: two quick experiments: 1) force kernel_selector to prefer fused paged (env KSEL_PREFERENCE=fused_paged) 2) run with KV layout separate (non-interleaved)
carla: did 1) — latency returned to baseline (2.6ms). did 2) — also helped but less stable.
devin: suggests selector logic: our cost model underestimates memory access overhead for interleaved bf16 paths. probably missing stride penalty term.
raj: can you try a micro-bench: run `./bin/attn_bench --kernel flashmix --kv-layout interleaved --dtype bf16 --seq 2048 --bs 4` and `--kernel fused_paged` and post times?
carla: pasted results from that micro-bench: flashmix 3.08ms, fused_paged 2.62ms, paged-only 2.71ms (all averaged over 100 iters).
marta: confirms misprediction. I can add a quick stride penalty: cost += (stride % 64 != 0) ? 0.15*mem_cost : 0.0 and push to canary for feedback.
devin: also consider that the continuous-batching heuristic increases batch windows for flashmix which exacerbates cache thrash for interleaved KV. maybe tighten window when interleaved.
carla: any objections to landing both fixes (stride penalty + reduce batch-window for interleaved) in canary?
raj: +1. add test coverage in perf harness: synthetic interleaved bf16 + long seq to catch regressions.
marta: will put up a short PR and include perf numbers. labeling it `perf:kv-interleave-stride`
carla: thanks — after PR lands, I'll re-run the nightly and report back. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: NOTE: created perf alert ticket INF-8731 for regressions >15% on long-context job
carla: assigning INF-8731 to @marta and @devin for follow-up.
devin: ack, will validate selector heuristics and add unit for cost model.
marta: ack, will push canary changes and perf tests.
carla: closing loop here — keeping thread for results, will post diffs once CI finishes.
